answer.rationale: Contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew and the line is at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, so deferring or switching vendors now adds delivery risk we cannot absorb; memory_c1 shows the incumbent keeps integration and deliveries stable. The 18% cost mandate points to negotiation: memory_c4 shows benchmarking at renewal moved the incumbent on price and payment terms, and memory_c6 shows multi-year commitment unlocked volume pricing. I am verifying c4 and c6 before committing because they carry the cost-recovery claim. Adding a second source (c3) is valuable but is a second decision; capacity allows only one this cycle. Flagging risk: an 18% cut may exceed what negotiation alone recovers, so terms should include a path to dual-sourcing next review.
